subject.title: Control UI: make the brand open the start screen and pin core pages by default

question: Should fresh or invalid Control UI preferences pin Usage, Cron, and Plugins by default, while an explicitly persisted empty list remains empty?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but selecting the permanent first-run sidebar hierarchy is a product and UX default decision rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Pin the three core pages
options.body: Adopt Usage, Cron, and Plugins as the ordered default while preserving every valid persisted customization.

options.title: Fix brand navigation only
options.body: Route the brand to `/new` but retain the deliberately empty first-run pinned list.

options.title: Choose another default set
options.body: Confirm a different ordered subset of workspace routes before implementation.

recommendation.title: Pin the three core pages
recommendation.body: Adopt Usage, Cron, and Plugins as the ordered default while preserving every valid persisted customization.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current chat-first sidebar behavior, opened this correction, and are the live assignee.
